AlarmDescription: More than 20% of evaluator results across the fleet are throttled (ThrottlingException from the Bedrock judge model). Remediation levers are the eval-config sampling rate and evaluator count in deploy/evaluations/setup-evaluations.sh. In-evaluator backoff/retry is impossible: the AWS Bedrock AgentCore Online Evaluations service executes the evaluators. If throttling persists at the reduced load profile, a Bedrock quota increase is a human/ops follow-up (AWS support ticket). Fires on 2 of 3 hourly datapoints. INSUFFICIENT_DATA when no evaluator results arrive.
